args.title: Brannock Legal subscription renewal — 15 November 2026
args.body:
Dear Brannock Legal team,

Your Halcyon Software annual subscription renews on 15 November 2026. This note sets out what is included in the coming term and the renewal price, so you can review both before that date.

With this renewal, the subscription includes:

- Single sign-on
- Audit export
- A 99.9% uptime commitment

Your current annual price is $42,000.00. The renewal price is $58,800.00 per year, a 40% increase. That updated price applies from your renewal date of 15 November 2026.

Please reply if you would like to discuss the renewal or the new features before then.

Kind regards,
Chris Moreau
Account Manager
Halcyon Software
